Commentary.Commentary: Now, it's over to the South African batting. They have shown good form in the series so far but today they will be under pressure of chasing a 350-plus score. Can they do it? Do join us in a short while to find out.

The South African bowlers looked completely out of sorts today. Their bowling struggled big time on a pitch which looks to be quite flat. Apart from Imran Tahir, who managed decent bowling figures, the rest of the bowlers were taken for a ride. Their prime bowler, Dale Steyn had his worst outing in ODIs and ended with figures of 2/96 in 10 overs.

Aaron Finch failed to convert his start and was consumed by Imran Tahir but what followed next was even better for Australia - a 124-run partnership between Warner and Smith. The duo started a bit slowly but then picked up the scoring rate. David Warner scored a sumptuous century and Steven Smith, too, notched up a fantastic ton. The Aussies looked like losing momentum towards the end but the pair of Head and Wade amassed a 22-ball 46 stand to provide them an excellent finishing touch.

A cracking batting show by the Aussies! Electing to bat, the Australian openers provided a solid start. The pair of Warner and Finch looked in killer mood and went berserk from the word go. They took the South African bowlers to the cleaners and raised a century stand in no time.

OUT! Rabada lets out a full toss on middle and Head tries to heave it across the line. But it catches the top edge and balloons in the air on the off side. Rabada runs towards the cover region and Faf du Plessis also moves forward to attempt for the catch inside the ring. No calling whatsoever and eventually it's the bowler who completes the catch and avoids the big collision. Du Plessis has a smile on his face. Could have been a nasty collision. Anyway, AUSTRALIA END ON 371/6, the highest total at this venue!
Slower short ball on off, Head is deceived by the slowness of the ball and is early into the pull shot. He ends up missing the ball completely.
Fuller and around off, drilled down the ground for a couple of runs as the long on fielder ran across to his left to make the stop.
FOUR! Excellent use of the feet from Head, he moves back and runs forward to take it on the full and powers it down the ground for a boundary.
Fine delivery, a dipping yorker, Wade digs it out through mid on and crosses for a single.
A low full toss on off, Head makes space and pushes it through cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Oh, good shot! Steyn serves it full and outside off, Wade attacks the room and pummels it over mid off for a boundary. 18 runs off the over!

In the air... safe! A length ball on off, Wade gets down a bit and paddle scoops it over short fine leg. The fielder in the deep is late in taking off and hence it falls just short of him. A couple of runs taken.
Too full in length on off, Head drills it back past the bowler for a single. This is now Steyn's worst bowling figures in ODIs, also the worst at this venue.
FOUR! Bang! Back of a length delivery outside off, Head keeps his balance inside the crease and whacks it through extra cover for a crunching boundary.
SIX! Mighty! Steyn delivers a slower full ball on off, Head goes down on one knee and thwacks it over wide long on for a biggie.
Shortish and on off, a mistimed pull shot to mid off for a single.
Fuller and on off, driven through extra cover for a couple of runs.
A low full toss just outside off, Head flashes and misses.
FOUR! Shot! Rabada comes up with a length ball around off, Head camps back and smacks it over mid-wicket for a muscular boundary.

DROPPED BY PHEHLUKWAYO! Rabada serves a shortish ball around off, Head heaves it across the line but fails to get enough meat of his bat behind it. The ball balloons in the air, Andile runs forward from the deep but fails to grab the catch. A couple taken.
Shortish and angling into the batsman, Wade gets back and pushes it with an angled bat through cover-point for a run.
SIX! Back of a length ball around leg, Wade attacks it with all his might and pulls it thunderously over backward square leg for a biggie.
Kagiso Rabada is back on.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Head latches onto the room and whacks it over mid off. The fielder is inside the ring and hence it's good enough for a couple of runs.
Length ball on middle, Wade advances down the track and pushes it to covers for a single.
Fuller in length and around off, Wade drags it off the inside half of the bat through mid-wicket. A single taken.
Good length ball on off, Wade taps it down towards mid on and quickly runs to the other end.
Matthew Wade is the new batsman.

OUT! Bowled 'em! This can cost Australia at least 20-30 runs! Steyn delivers a well-disguised slower delivery in the line of the stumps, Smith hops back, makes room to force it through the line but fails to make any connection. It goes through to rattle the stumps and Steyn roars in joy. End of a well compiled knock by the Aussie skipper. Can Australia end on a high from here on?
FOUR! Now, there is no stopping Steven Smith! Steyn drops it on a length outside off, Smith gets across the stumps and heaves it over square leg for a boundary.
Stays back footed and punches a shortish ball to sweeper cover for a single.
6th ODI hundred for Steven Smith.

FOUR! Sublime! What a way to bring up your century! Phehlukwayo once again overpitches outside off and Smith drives it elegantly through cover-point for a glorious boundary. A cracking knock by Smudge and he takes his helmet off before raising his bat towards the Australian dressing room. A captain's knock!
Short on off, pulled behind square leg for a run.

A touch short of a length ball on middle and off, Smith plays an ugly pull shot through the vacant mid-wicket region. The bowler runs after it and tries to stop the ball with a slide. He fails to do so but the batsmen already have given up the thought for the second run.
FOUR! Pristine! A quality shot from a quality batsman. An overpitched ball on this occasion, outside off, Smith leans forward and unfurls a sweet square drive for a boundary.
FOUR! Up and just over short third man! Short and wide outside off, Smith jumps on the back foot and upper cuts it over the fielder inside the ring for a boundary.
Andile Phehlukwayo is back into the attack.
FOUR! French cut from Head! He tries to power a shortish ball across the line on the leg side but gets a thick inside edge past the stumps for a boundary at fine leg.
Good length ball on middle, Smith remains on the back foot and turns it through square leg for a run.
Pitches it full and outside off, Head mistimes his drive to mid off for a single.
Bouncer to greet the new batsman, Head ducks underneath it.
Travis Head is the new batsman.

OUT! Excellent catch by Miller! He serves a back of a length ball on middle, 148 kph, Marsh stays back to pull it across the line over mid-wicket but fails to middle it. It flies towards the fielder inside the circle and Miller dives to his left to complete a superb catch.
On a length and wide outside off, Smith hangs back and slaps it to sweeper cover for a single. 300 up for Australia!
Googly around off, spinning in, Marsh defends it off his front foot. End of Tahir's spell - 10-0-54-2!
A touch short and on off, Smith hangs back and cuts it through covers for a single.
Floated ball outside off, it's driven through mid off for a single.
Spinning away from the batsman, Marsh tries to slog but misses.
Tossed up ball on leg, defended off the pads to mid-wicket.
Flighted ball around leg, Smith flicks it aerially over square leg and runs the first run hard. It has gone straight towards the fielder in the deep and hence there is no chance of the second run.
Shortish and on off, Smith doesn't get enough bat behind his attempted pull shot and hence it goes down through mid on for a single.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside. One run added to the total.
Third man drops back.
Fullish and outside off, Smith nudges it to covers and scampers across for a brisk single. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end but fails to find the stumps.
Goes on the back foot to a shortish ball and punches it to covers.
SIX! Steyn angles in a length ball on middle and leg, Smith shuffles across the stumps and hoists it over backward square leg for a biggie. Fine connection from a fine batsman.
Slower length ball outside off, Smith plays from the crease to point.
Dale Steyn is back into the attack.
Flatter ball around middle and leg, Marsh fails to connect with his attempted flick shot.
Wrong 'un on this occasion, on middle, Smith gets back and turns it through square leg for one.

Beautifully bowled! A lovely leg spinner drifting into the batsman and landing around off, Smith tries playing it with a straight bat but it spins away to beat the outside edge. Not very far from off stump.
Slow loopy ball on off, Smith drives it through the gap at covers and comes back for another couple of runs.
Flatter and fuller on middle, Smith whips it to deep mid-wicket for another brace.
Walks down the track and chips it over mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Imran Tahir is back into the attack.
Slips a full ball down the leg side, good change in pace, Marsh tries to flick but misses. It goes off his pads to the keeper.
Mitchell Marsh arrives.

OUT! Terrific catch by Faf du Plessis! Phehlukwayo serves a slower length ball around off, 117.9 kph, Bailey goes back inside the crease and slaps it through the line. But he fails to keep it down and du Plessis at covers dives full length to his left to take a cracking catch. A good looking innings cut short!

SIX! Up and over for a biggie! Fullish ball angling into the batsman, Bailey clears his front leg and swings it handsomely over mid-wicket for a sixer. 3000 ODI runs for Bailey, joint fastest for Australia!
Short and outside off, slower in pace, Smith pulls it across the line, deliberately keeps it down and finds the gap at mid-wicket for one.
Angles in a full ball on off, Bailey walks down the track and forces it to long on for one.
Shortish and outside off, Bailey stays back and slaps it over cover-point for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Full and on the pads, Smith helps it on its way to the fine leg region. The ball wins the race and goes past the fence. Smith moves to 70.
Landed outside off, Smith pushes it towards point.
On middle and off, Bailey flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.
Landed outside off, Smith taps it to the off side for a quick single.
WIDE! Banged in short, angling down the leg side, Smith lets it go over him. The umpire signals a wide.
Landed outside off, Steven pushes it to covers.
FOUR! Full toss outside off, Bailey smashes it over the point region and gets a boundary to end the over.

In the air... but safe! Shortish on middle and off, Smith goes for the pull but doesn't play it completely, hence gets a top edge. The ball lands safely near square leg and there is no one out there. Single taken.
Short of a length ball on off, Bailey mistimes his pull to long on for a single again.
Fullish around off, pushed through mid on for a run.
On the pads, Smith works it through square leg for a couple.
Fuller length ball outside off, Bailey drives it through mid off for a single.

Fuller length ball, swinging in, Bailey flicks it to mid-wicket. Amla runs to his left from square leg and does really well to stop the ball near the rope. Three runs taken by the batsmen. Good effort by Amla there, he's been tested as a fielding today.
Length ball outside off, Bailey pushes it to covers but finds the fielder.
WIDE! Angles it down the leg side again. Another wide. 250 UP FOR AUSTRALIA!
Fuller length ball on off, George clears his front leg and lofts it towards wide long on. Two runs taken.
Good length ball outside off, Bailey pushes it to point.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Bailey tries to flick but misses. The umpire signals a wide.
Length ball on middle and off, Bailey works it through square leg and comes back for the second.
Good length ball outside off, angling away, Steven plays it past point for a single.
Landed outside off, Smith plays it through covers again for yet another single.
Tad short outside off now, Bailey punches it to covers for a single again.
Full outside off, Smith drives it back to the bowler. Tahir fails to stop the ball and it goes towards long off. Single taken.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball but fails.
Outside off, Smith pushes it to covers but finds the fielder.
Landed outside off, Bailey reverse sweeps it towards third man and takes three runs. There is a throw at the striker's end but the batsman makes it in.
Short of a length ball outside off, Smith goes for the pull but misses.
Good length ball outside off, Steven defends it into the ground.
Landed around off, Smith defends it off his back foot.
RISKY! Tad short outside off, Bailey taps it to covers and sets off. Miller collects the ball and throws it at the striker's but misses his shy. Steven Smith gives up and luckily survives.
Length ball on off, Bailey defends it off his back foot.
Smith flicks it through square leg and takes a single.
South Africa targeting more wickets and bring back one of their strike bowlers.
Kagiso Rabada is back on.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
BOLDSTARTS George Bailey BOLDENDS is the new batsman, replacing Warner.
GEORGE BAILEY is the next man in.

OUT! One too many, David Warner! Fullish on middle and off, Warner gets down on his knee and goes for another slog sweep. This time he mistimes it as the ball goes high up in the air. Duminy keeps his eye on the ball, gets under it near wide long on and takes a safe catch. David Warner's sensational knock comes to an end then. Nevertheless, holds the record for the highest score by an Australian in ODIs at this venue. Tahir gets his second scalp and he starts celebrating again.
Full outside off, David drives it to covers where the fielder fumbles a bit.
SIX! EVEN BETTER! Fullish on middle and leg, Warner gets down on his knee and slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket region. The ball goes all the way for a biggie.
FOUR! What a shot! Landed around off, Warner gets into the position quickly and reverse sweeps it over covers for a boundary. No fielder in the deep there.
Fullish outside off, Smith drives it through covers for a single.
Fullish on the pads, Warner sweeps it straight to the short fine leg fielder.
Very full on off, Warner pushes it towards mid off where du Plessis dives to stop the ball but fails to do so. The batsmen take a couple. Good running between the wickets!
Full ball outside off, Warner goes for the reverse sweep but misses. The ball brushes his elbow though.
Short again outside off, Smith punches it through point this time for a single.

FOUR! Poor ball, punished! Half-tracker on middle and off, Smith transfers his weight onto his back foot and whips it over mid-wicket for a boundary. The fielder is a bit square and fails to get near the ball.
Shortish outside off, Smith goes onto his back foot and punches it towards the cover fielder.
JP Duminy comes back on.
15th ODI fifty for Steven Smith!
Loopy ball outside off, Steven Smith comes forward and drives it past mid off for a single. That brings up his fifty as well.
Full on off, driven through mid off by Warner for a single.
Fullish outside off, Warner drives it to covers where Miller does well to stop the ball.
Full outside off, driven through covers by Warner for a couple.
Landed outside off, Warner punches it through cover-point for a couple.
100-run stand up between Warner and Smith!
Landed around off, Smith comes forward and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Landed around off, Smith flicks it through the leg side for a single.
8th ODI ton for David Warner!
CENTURY! Length delivery on off, David Warner taps it to the off side for a quick single. That brings up his century as well. Been a superb knock so far!
FOUR! Fuller length ball outside off, Warner tries to play it through the off side but gets an outside edge. The ball goes towards the third man fence for a boundary and Warner moves to 99.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Good length ball on middle and leg, David clips it through mid-wicket for another quick run.
Good length ball on off, Smith taps it to mid on and takes a quick single. Du Plessis comes running there but fails to stop the batsmen.
Fullish on middle and leg, Warner flicks it towards mid-wicket but finds the fielder.
Short and wide outside off, Smith punches it through covers for a single. 200 up for Australia!

ALMOST A WICKET! Fullish on middle and leg, Warner tries to hit it across but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball just misses the stumps as well. The batsmen take a quick single. Stumping chance missed by de Kock as the keeper was blinded there.
Very full outside off, David mistimes it towards mid off where Tahir himself runs to stop it.
Low full toss outside off, Warner tries to drive but the ball goes off the outside half of the bat towards point where the fielder does well to stop the ball.
Landed around off, Warner gets onto his front foot and defends.
Imran Tahir is back!
FOUR! Steyn offers width outside off, it's on the shorter length as well, Smith flays at it and finds the gap through point for a boundary.

Appeal for an lbw! Full in length and outside off, Smith gets across the stumps and tries to flick it on the leg side. He fails to connect and is hit on the front pad. They appeal but the impact is outside off. The umpire shakes his head.
Lands it on a length around off, Smith stays back and tries to push it through covers but it comes off the inside half of the bat and rolls back to the bowler.
Full in length on middle and off, Warner rocks back and slaps it through cover-point for a single.

Slightly short in length on middle and leg, Smith gets across the stumps and tries to work it around. But he fails to make any connection and it goes off his thigh pad to short fine leg. A leg bye taken.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Dale Steyn is back on as well. South Africa in desperate need of a wicket.
FOUR! Lovely placement! Good length ball angling away from the batsman, Warner camps back and plays a late cut to find the gap between short third man and backward point.
FOUR! Boom! Pretorius serves a full ball outside off, slower in pace, Warner picks the change in pace in a trice and drills it down the ground for a boundary.
Angles in a full ball on middle, Smith eases it through mid on for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Full length ball outside off, Smith strides forward and plays a crisp cover drive for a boundary. Good to watch!
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
Length ball on off, Smith goes hard at it and gets an inside edge past the stumps to fine leg. A single taken.
Dwaine Pretorius is back on.
Flatter and outside off, Warner dabs it down to short third man and looks for a run. Sent back by his skipper.

Almost a run out! Flighted ball on off, Smith goes back and punches it on the leg side. It races through mid on but the mid-wicket fielder du Plessis runs swiftly across to his left and dives to stop the ball. He back flicks it towards the bowler's end but the ball goes wide of Tahir. Smith had already given up and gets a life.
Long hop outside off, Warner stands back and punches it to point where Rilee Rossouw makes a diving stop. They pick up a single.
Full floated and on off, another googly, it's drilled back past the bowler for a single down the ground.
Googly landing outside off, Smith goes back in defense and does so off the inside half of the bat.
Tossed up ball outside off, it's driven off the front foot to cover-point.
Imran Tahir is back into the attack.
Loopy ball on off, Smith pushes it through covers for one.
Slider on middle, skidding in, Warner helps it towards square leg for a single.
Too full in length on off, Warner digs it out to mid off.
Flighted outside off, driven to sweeper cover for a single.
Shortish and outside off, Warner cuts it through cover-point for a single.
Tossed up ball outside off, Smith drives it through extra cover and once again Amla's fitness is put to test. He does well to cut it off and this time the pair runs three.
Very full in length and outside off, Warner drills it through point where Amla moves across to his right from sweeper cover to make a diving stop. A couple of runs taken.
Slow in pace and fuller in length around off, Smith gets across the stumps a bit and whips it through backward square leg for a single.
Angles in a full ball on off, Smith gets forward with an angled bat and pushes it to cover-point.
Knocks a full ball down through mid off for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full in length and outside off, Smith drives it through the line and Miller at short extra cover makes a flying stop to his right.
Tossed up ball outside off, Warner punches it to covers where he fails to find the gap.
Flighted ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter and on off, Smith cuts it through covers for a run.
Quicker delivery, full and outside off, Warner drives it through the line towards the cover region where Miller makes a partial stop. They cross for a single.
50-run stand comes up!
Flighted full ball outside off, Smith gets on the front foot and drives it through cover-point for a single.
Good length ball on middle and off, angling away, Warner stays back and gently pushes it through covers for a couple of runs.
Too full in length wide outside off, Warner mistimes his drive to point.
Fullish and on off, Warner plays a firm square drive and it goes on one bounce to point. Rossouw does well to stop it from racing away.
Wide! Angles down a length ball, it's well outside leg, this time Warner tries to flick but misses.
Fuller on middle, slower in pace, Warner pushes it from the crease to short extra cover.
Wide! Good length delivery down the leg side, Warner lets it through to the keeper.
Too full in length outside off, Smith reaches out for it and drives it through covers for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
A touch short again, around middle, Smith goes deep inside the crease and punches it to long on for a run.
FOUR! It's uppish but wide of the fielder! Duminy fires in a shorter length ball on middle and leg, Smith gets back inside the crease and pulls it across the line past square leg for a boundary.
Slower one, full and outside off, Smith pushes it to short extra cover.
Slider on off, skidding in, Warner goes back and punches it through cover-point for a single. Played it very late.
Loopy ball on middle, Warner gets forward and defends it back watchfully.
Tossed up ball on off, shaping in, Smith goes back and punches it to long on for a single.
Fractionally short and outside off, Smith stands tall and pushes it through covers for a single.
Arrows in a very full ball on off, Smith stays back and pushes it with a straight bat to mid off.
Good length delivery on off, Smith rocks back and punches it to the off side. Not in the gap again.
Lands it on a length and outside off, Smith plays from the crease to point.
Slower length ball outside off, angling away, 115.2 kph, Warner camps back and pushes it through cover-point for a single.
Full in length and around middle, Warner gets behind the line and defends it back to the bowler.
Wide! Phehlukwayo digs in a short ball and it goes well over the head of the batsman. Called a wide for height!

Uppish and just wide of the fielder! Flighted full ball on off, stopping a bit onto the batsman, Warner checks his drive at the last moment and pushes it aerially to the off side. The short extra cover fielder dives to his left but it goes wide of him. A single taken.
Flatter ball outside off, forced past the bowler to long on for a single.

Almost drags it on! A touch flatter and around off, Warner stands back to force it through the off side but gets an inside edge onto his front pad. It rolls towards mid-wicket and they steal a single.
Shortish and on off, Smith gets back and hits it to cover-point for a quick single.
Flatter ball on off, Smith stands back to punch it through the line but it takes an inside edge and rolls to short mid-wicket.
Full flighted ball on off, Warner hangs back and pushes it past the diving cover fielder for a single.
Back of a length ball around the hips, Warner stands back and turns it down to fine leg for a run.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Tonk! Short of a length ball on off, Warner gets on top of the bounce and hammer-pulls it to the mid-wicket fence. That came right from the middle of the bat.
Shout for an lbw! Warner fails to work a length ball on the leg side and is hit on the pads. They appeal but the umpire shows no interest. Pitching outside leg, confirms the replays.
On a good length and outside off, Smith stays back and cuts it down to third man for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, holding its line, Smith plays from the back foot to covers.
Full ball on off, skidding in, Warner gets forward to defend but it goes off the inside part of the bat to short mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball on off, Smith walks forward a bit and forces it through mid on for a single.
Flighted ball on off, it's driven through mid off for a single.
A slider on off, skidding in, Warner goes deep inside the crease and punches it straight to the cover fielder.
Flatter and a touch shorter outside off, Smith makes space and cuts it through point for a single.
Slower loopy ball on off, Smith goes on the back foot in defense.
JP Duminy comes into the attack to bowl his offies.
Full in length on off, Warner pushes it off his back foot to extra cover where the fielder misfields but Steven Smith turns down the single. Never run off a misfield says the old cricket cliche!
Wayward delivery, short and down the leg side, Warner fails to middle his pull shot and it goes off his gloves to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Digs in a short ball on off, Smith pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Play and a miss! On a fuller length outside off, cutting in a bit, Smith tries to run it down to third man but misses. It goes very closely past the inside edge.
Back of a length ball outside off, Smith stands tall and taps it down to short cover.
Full in length and around leg, Warner flicks it through square leg for a single.
Andile Phehlukwayo comes into the attack.
Drinks break.
Angles across a full length ball outside off, Warner drives it with good timing through covers and takes a single.
Fuller and slower outside off, Smith drives it down to long on for one.
Good length ball on off, Warner eases it off his back foot through covers and jogs across to the other end.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.

Lands it on a fuller length and around off, Warner gets back and gently pushes it towards cover-point. Rossouw charges to the ball and dives to his left to take the pace off the ball. They cross for a brisk single.
Fullish and on off, Smith forces it down through mid on for a single.
Helps it with the spin through square leg for a single.
Full floated ball on off, Smith gets forward and pushes it on one bounce to the bowler. Tahir stretches to his left to collect the ball.
Tossed up ball on middle, Warner gets back and works it through square leg for one.
Quicker one, flat and on middle, Smith gets back and eases it through square leg for a single.
Flighted leg spinner on off, Smith strides forward and defends it to the off side.
Flatter full ball around leg, Warner pushes it past the diving bowler for a single down to long on.
Full length ball on middle and off, Warner stays back and pushes it past the diving cover fielder for a single.
Full in length and on middle, 132.5 kph, Smith works it through mid-wicket and takes a single.
Slower delivery, full and just outside off, 116.5 kph, Smith pushes it off the outside half of the bat to covers.
Action replay of the previous delivery.
Angles in a full ball around off, Smith gets across the stumps and brings down a straight bat in defense.
Fuller length ball outside off, slower in pace, Smith drives it off his front foot to mid off.
Googly again by Tahir but it's a bit on the shorter side, Smith gets the time to go back and work it through mid-wicket for a run.
Flighted and full outside off, Smith drives it through covers and gets off the mark with a couple of runs.
Wrong 'un around off, Smith defends it off the inside half of the bat.
Slow loopy full ball outside off, Smith gets on the front foot and defends it watchfully to the off side.
Tossed up ball on off, Warner drives it through mid off for a single.
Skipper Steven Smith walks in next.

OUT! Finch holes out! A tossed up ball outside off, spinning away a shade, Finch tries to power it down the ground but it curves away to catch the top edge. The ball balloons in the air, Rabada comes ahead from long off and grabs the skier to perfection. Tahir sets off in celebration and is all pumped up. End of a good knock by Aaron but he will be disappointed with his shot selection. There was a century for the taking.
Slower delivery, on a length and outside off, Warner pushes at it and gets beaten because of a lack of pace.
Full and on middle, worked on the leg side but straight to the fielder.
Turns it off his pads to the leg side for a run.
14th ODI fifty for Aaron Finch.

SIX! Boom, fifty for Aaron Finch as well. Pretorius serves a slower full ball on off, Finch picks it early and launches it over long on for a biggie. Catch it was the shout initially but it's taken by a spectator in the crowd.
A length delivery outside off, Finch hits it with an angled bat through point. Amla makes a tumbling stop in the deep and they take a couple of runs.
Back of a length ball outside off, a swing and a miss by Finch.
Flighted and full outside off, it's pushed off the front foot to covers.
A wrong 'un this time, around off, Warner picks it late and defends it towards covers.
17th ODI fifty for David Warner! 100-run stand comes up as well.

FOUR! Bang! Floated leg spinner landing around off, Warner goes down on one knee and rifles it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Fine knock by the Aussie vice-captain and he is looking in great touch. Great start for Australia as well.
Tossed up ball on off, Finch goes down on one knee and sweeps it through square leg for a run.
A tossed up ball outside off, Warner drives it through mid off for a single.
Full flighted ball on off, Warner gets forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Imran Tahir to bowl his leggies.
Full and on off, shaping in a bit, Finch gets forward and defends it close to his front pad.
Fullish and outside off, Warner pushes it towards extra cover where Miller dives to make a partial stop. He parries it towards mid off and then runs after it. They cross for a single.
Slower full ball angling into the batsman, Aaron flicks it through mid-wicket and runs the first run hard. He looks for the second run as well but the fielder in the deep is quick to the ball.
Full in length around leg, Warner clips it through square leg for a single.
Back of a length ball on off, Warner pulls it firmly across the line but finds Amla at short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Fine shot! A fuller length ball on off, Warner gets on the front foot and smashes it through the line. Once again middles his shot to perfection and beats the long off fielder.
Powerplay 2 time!
Good length ball on off, Finch covers the line and blocks it down safely.
SIX! Up and over the fence! Rabada digs in a short ball around off, Finch leans back and plays the ramp shot. It flies off the middle of the bat and clears the fence with ease.

Appeal for an lbw! Full length ball on leg, angling down, Finch tries to flick it across the line but fails to do so. He is hit low on the pads, a stifled appeal but nothing from the umpire. Missing leg!
A low full toss angling into the batsman, Finch flicks it across the line but finds the short mid-wicket fielder.
Goes on the back foot to a shortish ball and punches it through cover-point for a couple of runs.
FOUR! French cut by Finch! Back of a length ball on off, Aaron goes on the back foot to pull it across the line but it catches the inside edge and screams past the stumps to the fine leg fence.
Angles across a length ball on off, slower in pace, Warner dabs it to point, once again looks for a single but Finch sends him back.
Tries to tap down a length ball to point and take a single but the fielder quickly gets to the ball and Finch sends his partner back.
Good length delivery on off, Warner sticks to his back foot and defends it to the off side.

In the air... safe! Pretorius slows down his pace and lands it on a fuller length around middle and leg, Warner is deceived a bit but still goes on with his shot. He lofts it just over mid on and collects a brace.
Slower full ball on middle, Warner plays it with soft hands to mid on.
Fuller and wider outside off, Finch drills it down the ground and du Plessis dives full length to his right at mid off to save a certain boundary. Cannot prevent the single though.
Dwaine Pretorius is introduced into the attack.

Full in length and on off, Finch gets forward and pushes it back with a straight bat. Just wide of mid on and Tahir gives it the chase. The Aussie openers collect three runs. A better throw would have had Finch in trouble.
Fullish and outside off, it's driven through mid off for a single.

FOUR! One bounce and into the fence. Rabada bangs in a short ball on middle, Warner initially shapes up for the pull shot but then tries to pull out. But he ends up getting a top edge in the process and it goes over short leg for a boundary. Just prior to this ball, fine leg was brought back inside the circle.
Mid on drops back and fine leg comes up.
Back of a length ball on middle, Warner gets on top of the bounce and taps it down to mid-wicket.
Almost nicks it! Good length delivery on off, zipping away off the surface, Warner tries to run it down but fails to connect.
Swing and a miss! Full length ball outside off, Warner goes down and tries to slog it over the leg side but fails to connect.
Steyn slows his pace this time and lands a full ball on middle, Finch stays back and defends it on the leg side.
SIX! Finch, you beauty! Steyn goes short with his length around off, Aaron turns inside the crease and smokes it over mid-wicket for a flat biggie.
SIX! High and handsome! Steyn angles in a length ball on middle and leg, Finch picks it off his pads and smacks it all the way over wide long on for a maximum.
Wide! Full in length and way wide outside off, slower in pace, Finch has an easy leave.
Good length delivery outside off, Finch goes on the back foot and pushes it on the up to short extra cover.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Warner goes back to make some space and taps it down to point for a single.

Full in length and angling away from the batsman, Warner delays his shot a bit and calmly pushes it through backward point. A couple of runs taken and 50 comes up for Australia. It's been an excellent start for them.

Puts it on a fuller length around off, a hint of inward shape there, Finch quietly plays it through the gap at mid-wicket and comes back for the second run. Another excellent over for the Aussies, 11 runs off it.
Full and wide outside off, Warner throws his bat at it and it goes off the outside edge to third man. A single to rotate the strike.
Angles across a length ball outside off, Warner stays back and plays it down to point.

FOUR! Cracking shot! Stand and delivery from the Aussie vice-captain! A length ball around off, Warner attacks it with all his might and powers it over the bowler's head. It goes on one bounce to the fence.
FOUR! Good batsmen don't miss often! Warner once again receives a length ball in his half and he swings it over mid-wicket this time for a boundary.
Excellent fielding by Pretorius! Full length ball on middle, Warner flicks it across the line but fails to beat the mid-wicket fielder. A good diving stop by Dwaine.
Full again around middle, Warner plays it from the crease and flicks it off the inside half of the bat through square leg. A single to end the over. Good comeback by Steyn.
Fullish and around leg, Warner gets behind the line and defends it gently on the leg side.

Nearly a return catch! A length ball around leg, stopping a bit onto the batsman, Warner is early into his attempted flick shot and hence closes the face of the bat early. It pops in the air off the leading edge but doesn't carry to Steyn.
Just a shade short in length on middle and leg, Finch rises on his back foot and turns it through square leg for one.
Full length ball angling into the batsman around off, Finch covers the line and blocks it back to the bowler.
Wrong line from Steyn, he slips in a length ball down the leg side, Finch fails to flick and it goes off his thigh pad to fine leg. They cross for a couple of leg byes.
Movement once again back into the right-hander, Finch tries flicking across the line but it comes off the inside edge and rolls wide of short fine leg. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Good length ball on off, nipping in, Finch goes back to flick but misses and is hit on the front thigh pad.
A slip moves out to short mid-wicket. Now, there is only one slip in place for Finch.
Straighter in line, Finch works it on the leg side but finds the fielder.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Rabada angles in a length ball on middle, Finch picks it off his pads and flicks it over square leg for a boundary.
Wide! Back of a length delivery angling down the leg side, Finch tries to pull it but misses. It almost catches his gloves.
Good line from Rabada, bowls it on a fuller length and around middle and off, Warner gently taps it on the off side and sets off for a quick single.
Full length ball landing outside leg, Warner tries to flick but misses and is hit low on the pads.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Warner guides it to third man and retains strike with a single. 17 runs off the over!

Angles across a length ball outside off, Warner stays back and calmly runs it down past backward point. The third man fielder gets across to his left but tumbles while stopping the ball. The batsmen get the chance to take the second run.

FOUR! Uppish but safe! Steyn angles across a full length ball outside off, once again there is some width on offer and Warner latches onto it. He leans forward and drives it over extra cover for a boundary.
SIX! What a shot! Steyn goes short and lands it around middle and off, Warner goes deep inside the crease and smashes it handsomely over mid-wicket for a biggie. He is looking in killer mood.
Lands it on a length and outside off, Warner stays back and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
FOUR! Brutal! Steyn offers width outside off, angling away, Warner camps back and blasts it through covers for a cracking boundary.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Finch turns inside the crease and glances it elegantly through square leg for a lovely boundary.
A low full toss angling into the batsman, Finch gets forward and pushes it back to the bowler.
Finch is away! Identical to the last delivery, this time Aaron eases it past the left side of the short mid-wicket fielder and the mid on fielder gives the chase. A coupe of runs taken.
Angles in a full length ball on middle, Finch gets on the front foot and works it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Just a bit on the shorter side outside off, Aaron goes on the back foot and punches it nicely to the off side. But he finds the cover fielder.
Rabada straightaway gets some inward movement. Lands it on a length around off, Finch tries to flick but misses and is hit high on the front pad.
Kagiso Rabada to bowl from the other end. He, too, has a couple of slips in place.
Beautiful delivery to end the over. It's on a full length around off and nips away a bit after landing, Warner without any footwork has a nervous push inside the line and misses.
Play and a miss! This time Warner fails to restrain himself. He goes after a full and wide delivery outside off and gets beaten.
A tempter by Steyn, he puts it on a driving length outside off but Warner restrains himself and allows it through to the keeper.

FOUR! Warner is off the mark! Not in a convincing manner though! Steyn offers width wide outside off, Warner stays back and throws his bat at it. He fails to middle his shot and it comes off the bottom edge before racing straight down the ground for a boundary. Early signs that this pitch is on the slower side.
Bowls it closer to the off stump, on back of a length, Warner goes on the back foot and defends it down watchfully.
Starts with a fuller length delivery in the channel outside off, shaping away a shade, Warner stays back and has a watchful leave.
It's time to get going. David Warner and Aaron Finch are the Aussie openers. Dale Steyn to steam in first up with a couple of slips in place. Here we go...
South Africa - Quinton de Kock(w), Hashim Amla, Faf du Plessis(c), Rilee Rossouw, JP Duminy, David Miller, Dwaine Pretorius, Andile Phehlukwayo, Kagiso Rabada, Dale Steyn, Imran Tahir.
Australia - David Warner, Aaron Finch, Steven Smith(c), George Bailey, Mitchell Marsh, Travis Head, Matthew Wade(w), John Hastings, Adam Zampa, Chris Tremain, Daniel Worrall.

Toss - Steven Smith has won the toss and AUSTRALIA ELECT TO BAT! They have made one change and have brought Daniel Worrall in place of Joe Mennie. South Africa have two changes, Hashim Amla and Dwaine Pretorius come in place of Farhaan Behardien and Wayne Parnell(injured).

Hello and a warm welcome everyone for the third ODI between South Africa and Australia at Kingsmead, Durban. The visiting side has its backs to the wall and is in desperate need of a win today to stay alive in the series. South Africa, on the other hand, have played some exceptional cricket so far and have a rare series win against the world champions in sight. Let's hope for a cracking game...
